article.title: Qualification for membership of the State Legislature
article.content:
A person shall not be qualified to be chosen to fill a seat in the Legislature of a State unless he—
(a)1[is a citizen of India, and makes and subscribes before some person authorised in that behalf by the Election Commission an oath or affirmation according to the form set out for the purpose in the Third Schedule;]
(b)is, in the case of a seat in the Legislative Assembly, not less than twenty-five years of age and, in the case of a seat in the Legislative Council, not less than thirty years of age; and
(c)possesses such other qualifications as may be prescribed in that behalf by or under any law made by Parliament.

173Qualification for membership of the State Legislature

Article 173 · Part VI · General

A person shall not be qualified to be chosen to fill a seat in the Legislature of a State unless he—

(a)1[is a citizen of India, and makes and subscribes before some person authorised in that behalf by the Election Commission an oath or affirmation according to the form set out for the purpose in the Third Schedule;]

(b)is, in the case of a seat in the Legislative Assembly, not less than twenty-five years of age and, in the case of a seat in the Legislative Council, not less than thirty years of age; and

(c)possesses such other qualifications as may be prescribed in that behalf by or under any law made by Parliament.

1 Subs. by the Constitution (Sixteenth Amendment) Act, 1963, s. 4, for cl. (a)
